checkEmail.title: Check your inbox
checkEmail.body: We sent an email to <email>{{email}}</email>. Press the button in it to activate your account.
checkEmail.expires: The link works once and expires after 24 hours.
tips: Wait a moment — it usually arrives within a minute.
Look in your Spam, Promotions or Updates folder.
Check that the address above is correct.
checkEmail.resent: If this address is waiting for verification, a new email is on its way. Links in older emails no longer work.

manual.title: Resend verification email
manual.body: Enter the email you registered with and we'll send a new link.

success.title: Your account is active
success.body: Welcome {{name}}! You're signed in and ready to learn.
success.redirect: Taking you to the app in {{seconds}} seconds.

expired.title: This link has expired
expired.body: Verification links work for 24 hours. Press the button below to get a new email — no need to type your address again.
expired.sent: New email sent. Open the most recent one in your inbox.

used.title: This link was already used
used.body: Your email address is already verified, nothing else to do.

invalid.title: This link is not valid
invalid.body: The link may have been cut off when copied, or you requested a newer email. Open the latest email, or enter your address to get another one.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use the email and password you registered with.
login.rememberHint: Stay signed in for 30 days. Don't tick this on shared computers like library PCs.
login.submitHint: Pick up where you left off
login.invalid: The email or password is not correct.
login.attemptsLeft_one: {{count}} attempt left before sign-in is locked for 15 minutes.
login.attemptsLeft_other: {{count}} attempts left before sign-in is locked for 15 minutes.

locked.title: Sign-in is temporarily locked
locked.body: The password was entered wrongly 5 times in a row. To protect the account you can try again in:

locked.resetLink: Can’t remember it? Reset your password to unlock now

notVerified.body: This email address is not verified yet. Open the verification email or get a new one.

login.unavailable: This account cannot sign in right now. Please contact support.

reason.SESSION_REVOKED: This device was signed out from another device. Sign in again if that was you.
reason.loggedOut: You have signed out. See you soon!
reason.passwordReset: Your password was reset and every device was signed out. Sign in with your new password.

home.readyBody: {{email}} is verified. Study features will appear here as they ship.

devices.title: Signed-in devices
devices.subtitle: See where your account is signed in and sign out devices you no longer use.
devices.confirmBody: That device will need to sign in again on its next action.

devices.confirmOthersBody_one: {{count}} other device will need to sign in again. This device stays signed in.
devices.confirmOthersBody_other: {{count}} other devices will need to sign in again. This device stays signed in.
devices.onlyThis: Only this device is signed in.
devices.tip: Got a new-device alert that wasn't you? Press the button in the email, or sign that device out right here.

revokeLink.alreadyTitle: That device was already signed out
revokeLink.alreadyBody: {{device}} was signed out earlier, nothing else to do.

revokeLink.failedTitle: Could not sign that device out

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.subtitle: Enter the email address you signed up with. We will send you a link to choose a new password.

sent.title: Check your inbox
sent.body: If <email>{{email}}</email> has a Learning Companion account, password reset instructions have been sent to it.
sent.expires: The link in the email works once and expires after 30 minutes.
sent.resent: Instructions sent again. Use the newest email, the link in older ones no longer works.
tips: Emails usually arrive within a minute. Check your Spam and Promotions folders too.
Double-check the address above. If it is wrong, use a different address.
For your security, we never say which addresses have an account.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: Pick a new password that differs from your old one. Once saved, every device signed in to this account will be signed out.

success.title: Your new password is set
success.body: Every device has been signed out and a confirmation email was sent to {{email}}.
success.cta: Sign in with your new password

expired.title: This link has expired
expired.body: Password reset links only work for 30 minutes. Get a new link, it will arrive in a moment.
expired.sent: A new link is on its way. Open the newest email in your inbox.

invalid.title: This link can no longer be used
invalid.body: It was already used, replaced by a newer link, or copied incompletely. Request a new link instead.

failed.title: We could not check this link

security.title: Account security
security.subtitle: Change your password and control which devices are signed in to your account.
security.neverChanged: Password not changed since the account was created

change.title: Change password
change.body: After the change, every other device is signed out. This device stays signed in.
change.newPlaceholder: At least 10 characters, ideally a phrase
change.confirmPlaceholder: Type it again to be sure
change.success_zero: Password changed. A confirmation email was sent to your inbox.
change.success_one: Password changed and {{count}} other device signed out. A confirmation email was sent to your inbox.
change.success_other: Password changed and {{count}} other devices signed out. A confirmation email was sent to your inbox.
change.attemptsLeft_one: {{count}} attempt left before the account is locked for 15 minutes.
change.attemptsLeft_other: {{count}} attempts left before the account is locked for 15 minutes.
change.lockedBody: The current password was entered wrong 5 times in a row. To protect your account, try again in:
change.unlocked: The lock has ended, you can try again.

sessions.title: Sign out of all devices
sessions.body: Use this if you forgot to sign out on a shared computer or think someone else got into your account. This device stays signed in.
sessions.count_zero: No other device is signed in.
